breakdown.description: The pressure field is floating because no reference pressure is set. For an incompressible simulation to converge, pressure must be fixed at least at one point, typically the outlet, with a `fixedValue` condition. Setting all pressure boundaries to `zeroGradient` will lead to a solver failure.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not address the floating pressure issue at all. Instead of fixing the outlet boundary condition from 'zeroGradient' to 'fixedValue' with 'value uniform 0', the agent merely asked an unrelated clarifying question about the FoamFile header format. The critical inconsistency—that all pressure boundaries are set to zeroGradient, leaving no reference pressure for the incompressible solver—was completely ignored.
